title: Memory Transplants: Cross-Domain Memory Transfer for LLM Agents
description: Factorial study disentangling architecture transfer vs. content transfer when transplanting memory across domains. Shows memory transplantation benefits smaller models most (+15pp for 3B), ExpeL's insight distillation enables meaningful static content transfer, and retrieval budget effects are non-monotonic.
status: Under review at ICLR 2026 MemAgent Workshop
